generalAbilities.name: Slow
generalAbilities.description: A sodden sentinel is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Tainted Guts
defensiveAbilities.description: When a sodden sentinel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it explodes, dealing 6d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage to each creature in a 10ft Emanation (Basic DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that fails this save is also Blinded for 1d4 rounds (1 minute on a critical failure).

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pummel the Fallen
offensiveAbilities.description: A sodden sentinel's fist Strike deals an additional 2d6 damage to Prone creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Seawater Retch
offensiveAbilities.description: The sodden sentinel vomits up a supernaturally tainted wave of seawater in a 30ft Cone. Each living creature in the area takes 6d10 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save). It can't use Seawater Retch again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
